orders.text:
WPSS No. 14 of 2021
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. C.K.Sharma, Advocate for the petitioners
None for the respondent no.1. 
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, Advocate for the 
respondent nos. 2 to 4. 
Issue notice to respondent no.1. 
List after four weeks to enable the respondents to 
file counter affidavit. 
Heard on interim relief application no. 01 of 
2021. 
Petitioner seeks that respondents be restrained to 
make promotion pursuant to the seniority list dated 
21.11.2020. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as 
of now, there is no such proposal for promotion, 
therefore, this Court sees no reason to consider on 
this application, at this stage. 
However, as and when, the occasion arises, the 
petitioner is always free to move fresh application. 
Accordingly the interim relief application is 
rejected. 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 13.01.2021 Kaushal

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.14 of 2021
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. C.D. Bahuguna, learned senior
counsel assisted by Mr. Chandra Shekhar 
Dalakoti, learned counsel for the petitioner/ 
applicant.
2. Mr. I.D. Paliwal, learned Standing 
Counsel for respondent No.1.
3. Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel 
for respondent Nos.2 to 4.
4. Amendment Application No.2 of 2024 
has been moved by petitioner for
incorporating a prayer and certain 
paragraphs in the writ petition. 
5. On the previous date, respondents were 
directed to file objection(s), if any, to the 
amendment application. But, today, it is 
reflected from the record that no objection(s) 
has so far been filed by the respondents.
6. In this view of the matter, amendment 
application (IA/2/2024) is allowed. Let the 
necessary amendment, as sought for, be 
incorporated within 10 days from today, by 
taking necessary steps as per Rules.
7. Respondents are directed to file counter 
affidavits, if any, to the amended writ 
petition, within a period of six weeks.
8. List on 22.07.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
